snippet.title: Wielder of the Essence - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
We are Lavapotion, a small team from Sweden, and this is Wielders of the Essence! A game built around split-second decisions and short game sessions where “just one more run” is an easy decision. Become a powerful Wielder drawing magical strength from your troops. Gather weapons, discover spells and gain skills as you battle through chaos. This game sits comfortably right between oddly meditative and stressfully intense.

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/3546610/
